top_signals.title: Kipchoge Takes Running Mission Worldwide
top_signals.summary: Eliud Kipchoge is taking the next chapter of his legendary marathon career around the world. The two-time Olympic marathon champion, who became the first person to run a marathon in under two hours, is embarking on a multi-year World Tour that will take him across all seven continents. Fresh off a victory and course record at the Melbourne Marathon, Kipchoge joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss his mission to inspire more people to run, the mental challenge of breaking the two-hour barrier, and the philosophy behind his mantra “No Human Is Limited.” He also discusses his decades-long partnership with Nike to help transform racing-shoe technology. (Source: Bloomberg)
